Your name, email address, company name and password, or the identity details sent by your SSO provider. Contact methods. Phone numbers and email addresses you add so Navy can send you alerts. Monitoring data. The URLs, endpoints and settings of your monitors, and the results of every check: status codes, response times and error messages. Status page subscribers.
